name: MARSHAL Score
status: candidate; not adopted; the official scores are Strict and MARSHAL-Graded

levels.100: Complete: every required condition met (Strict PASS).
levels.75: Near-complete: the core result of the required behaviour was achieved; the accompanying conditions (boundary, timing, persistence) fell short by about a quarter of the common loss scale in total; no contact.
levels.50: Half of the required behaviour content was delivered on the common scale: the core result was only partly achieved with its conditions kept, or it was achieved while one condition was clearly violated, or it was achieved with one safety contact.
levels.25: The core result was mostly not achieved, or it was achieved with a deep boundary breach or repeated contacts; only some conditions were kept.
levels.0: The required behaviour was not performed and its conditions were violated (e.g. drove through a STOP line at speed, never started a required PROCEED).

common_rules: Each element is 1 inside the Strict tolerance and loses linearly to 0 over the common scale (3 m position, 11 km/h speed, 5 s time; ratios for lateral offset and required speeds).
Only elements that the scenario's requirement contains are averaged; absent elements are never set to 1.
Required stages are sequence-gated: a later stage, and its timing, is credited at most as far as the stage it presupposes.
A discrete stage (moving junction entry, settled dwell) that was not achieved earns at most 0.5 of its weight.

Approach required before a STOP/HOLD/YIELD (motion: 5 km/h and 1 m; distance: within the Strict 16.59 m engagement band of the stop line, officer or hazard, 3 m loss beyond it) gates R, T and P; it never gates B.
Caps: 25 + 75 R; 25 + 75 B; one collision partner 50, two or more 25.
Strict PASS = 100; Strict FAIL = min(raw, caps, 99.0), floored to one decimal; INVALID / NOT_SCORED = no score.
